en.answer: When resolving the effect of <<8900>>, if there are 2 or less "Laval" monsters in your Graveyard, the effect to Special Summon it is not applied. (<<8900>> remains in the Graveyard.)
en.question: If the effect of <<8900>> is activated, but the effect of <<6980>> is chained so that there are fewer than 3 "Laval" monsters in my Graveyard when the effect of <<8900>> resolves, how is it applied?
